deployment: Local only. Neither Preview nor Production deployed; no database migrations or member-asset changes.
rootCauses: Card content was partially shared but parent components separately painted frames, headers and footers, so reveals and collection cards had different composition.
Page-specific picker styles overrode the card aspect ratio and applied flex layout to every nested span.
Jersey number defaults and explicit per-surface overrides still reflected the earlier number-free brief.
Regional NFL locations fell through to a visible unavailable placeholder.

architecture.projection: src/core/card-presentation.ts: collectiblePresentation preserves identity, maps canonical snapshot team location, groups name suffixes and formats the existing serial/supply.
architecture.face: src/components/collectible-face.tsx owns all artwork and live text; compact, standard, detailed, reveal and lineup share a fixed 2:3 composition.
architecture.frame: src/components/collectible-frame.tsx supplies original decorative SVG geometry; src/core/rarity-theme.ts supplies all six materials without changing rarity rules.
architecture.jersey: src/components/player-jersey.tsx renders original SVG fabric, folds, stitching and printed verified numbers. Missing metadata stays number-free. No official logos or player photography.
architecture.context: FantasyCardArtwork wraps the canonical face. Scoring context, details and actions sit outside the collectible. Existing Social, Market, collections, private offers and pack history inherit it; Play, selectors and standings use the same face directly.
architecture.performance: Reusable vector/CSS layers, unique SVG gradient IDs, existing optimized brand assets, no new dependencies or continuous grid animations.

materials.Icon: Platinum/chrome with crown and white-blue highlights

failuresAndRetries: Initial typecheck/build found an unknown-typed receipt conditional; changed it to a boolean guard.
Initial lint found an unused brand import after reveal wrapper cleanup; removed it.
Initial keyboard test used mouse modality; corrected to exercise keyboard focus-visible.
Play regression exposed the old picker aspect-ratio override; removed it and narrowed nested-span rules, then passed all four viewports.
Name splitting omitted a text-node space between first and last name; restored the space and reran standings drilldown checks.
One Play rerun hit a Windows screenshot file-open error; subsequent evidence uses a unique run directory and passed.

Normal-motion sampling initially failed on TSX helper serialization, then on a string-evaluation attempt. Replaced it with browser-native animation-frame sampling. These were test-harness failures, not accepted passes.
visualComparison: Inspected real browser screenshots against the supplied reference. Sculpted chrome rails, inset dark separator, watermark, dominant original jersey, centred metallic surname, regional location and bottom serial/wordmark follow the reference. Artwork remains lightweight original vector illustration, not the reference's photorealistic rendered shirt.
limitations: All mutations and visual ownership are isolated synthetic fixtures, not real member accounts. The same-card comparison uses Taylor McBride with explicit fixture number metadata.
Physical Samsung S24, installed-app and hosted authenticated acceptance remain pending.
Existing data without verified jersey numbers remains number-free; no number lookup or roster reassignment was performed.
No financial activation, trading activation, public registration or production data changes.
